title: Cells with Odd Values in a Matrix
description: Given m x n matrix initialized to 0, increment all cells in row ri and column ci for each operation [ri, ci]. Return count of odd values.

steps.note: Initialize row and column increment counters to zeros.
Process first operation [0, 1]. Increment row 0 and col 1.
Process second operation [1, 1]. Increment row 1 and col 1.
